$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — ContentManifest. Major version 1. Caller-supplied literal content for composition (issue #23 G3): maps the design-source valueRefs already pinned in NodeIR content slots (design://<sourceId>/<locator>) to the text/media/link values a later gated compose stage may place into native platform content. The manifest carries LITERAL content only — it never introduces nodes, never invents asset URLs (an absent entry is reported as a gap by the composing adapter, never defaulted), and it is pinned to the same source revision as the PageStructure it feeds. Platform-neutral: mediaUrl/linkUrl are open strings; each platform adapter defines and documents its own accepted forms.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Content Manifest

profileId.description: Must equal the profile id of the run that produced the pinned PageStructure.

sourceRevisionId.description: Must equal PageStructure.source.revisionId — content is only valid for the revision it was observed against.

entries.description: One entry per (valueRef, kind). Duplicate pairs are a caller error (INPUT_CONTRACT_VIOLATION); the composing adapter never silently picks one.

valueRef.description: The design:// locator of the observed source node this content belongs to — exactly the valueRef already carried by the corresponding NodeIR content slot.

text.description: Required for kind=text: the literal display text observed/supplied for this node.

mediaUrl.description: Required for kind=media: an explicitly supplied asset reference in the TARGET platform's accepted form. Never a temporary design-tool URL; label placeholders via assetLabel.

assetLabel.description: Provenance label for a media entry (e.g. 'operator-supplied local asset' or 'labeled offline placeholder'). Free text; never parsed.

linkUrl.description: Required for kind=link: the explicit link target for the node (open form; the platform adapter validates what it can accept).

linkTarget.description: Optional link window target; default is the platform's own default.
